raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.95.8"

recipe:
  name: iceoryx-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/eclipse-iceoryx/iceoryx/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 00b1bf874e17b3e986f11cd134e2be339f3d12643b58b4544692cc4e820439ff
  patches:
    - patches/sha1_cannot_be_empty.diff
    - patches/windows_shared_exports.diff

build:
  number: 5
  script: build

outputs:
  - package:
      name: libiceoryx-platform
    build:
      files:
        - if: unix
          then: lib/libiceoryx_platform*
        - if: win
          then: Library/bin/iceoryx_platform*.dll
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - if: unix
          then: make
        - if: win
          then: ninja
      host:
        - if: linux
          then: libacl
        - if: unix
          then: ncurses
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libiceoryx_platform${SHLIB_EXT}
          - if: win
            then: if not exist "%LIBRARY_BIN%\iceoryx_platform.dll" exit 1

  - package:
      name: libiceoryx-hoofs
    build:
      files:
        - if: unix
          then: lib/libiceoryx_hoofs*
        - if: win
          then: Library/bin/iceoryx_hoofs*.dll
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - if: unix
          then: make
        - if: win
          then: ninja
      host:
        - if: linux
          then: libacl
        - if: unix
          then: ncurses
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-platform", exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-platform", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libiceoryx_hoofs${SHLIB_EXT}
          - if: win
            then: if not exist "%LIBRARY_BIN%\iceoryx_hoofs.dll" exit 1

  - package:
      name: libiceoryx-posh
    build:
      files:
        - if: unix
          then: lib/libiceoryx_posh*
        - if: win
          then: Library/bin/iceoryx_posh*.dll
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - if: unix
          then: make
        - if: win
          then: ninja
      host:
        - if: linux
          then: libacl
        - if: unix
          then: ncurses
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-hoofs", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-platform", exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-hoofs", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-platform", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libiceoryx_posh${SHLIB_EXT}
          - if: win
            then: if not exist "%LIBRARY_BIN%\iceoryx_posh.dll" exit 1

  - package:
      name: libiceoryx-binding-c
    build:
      files:
        - if: unix
          then: lib/libiceoryx_binding_c*
        - if: win
          then: Library/bin/iceoryx_binding_c*.dll
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - if: unix
          then: make
        - if: win
          then: ninja
      host:
        - if: linux
          then: libacl
        - if: unix
          then: ncurses
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-hoofs", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-posh", exact=True) }}
        - if: win
          then: ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-platform", exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-hoofs", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-posh", exact=True) }}
        - if: win
          then: ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-platform", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libiceoryx_binding_c${SHLIB_EXT}
          - if: win
            then: if not exist "%LIBRARY_BIN%\iceoryx_binding_c.dll" exit 1

  - package:
      name: libiceoryx-platform-devel
    build:
      files:
        - if: unix
          then: include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_versions.hpp
        - if: unix
          then: include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_versions.h
        - if: unix
          then: include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iox/
        - if: unix
          then: include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_platform/
        - if: unix
          then: lib/cmake/iceoryx_platform/
        - if: win
          then: Library/include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_versions.hpp
        - if: win
          then: Library/include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_versions.h
        - if: win
          then: Library/include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iox/
        - if: win
          then: Library/include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_platform/
        - if: win
          then: Library/lib/cmake/iceoryx_platform/
        - if: win
          then: Library/lib/iceoryx_platform*.lib
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - if: unix
          then: make
        - if: win
          then: ninja
      host:
        - if: linux
          then: libacl
        - if: unix
          then: ncurses
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-platform", exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-platform", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then: test -f ${PREFIX}/include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_versions.hpp
          - if: unix
            then: test -f ${PREFIX}/include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_versions.h
          - if: unix
            then: test -f ${PREFIX}/include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_platform/inet.hpp
          - if: win
            then: if not exist "%LIBRARY_INC%\iceoryx\v${{ version }}\iceoryx_versions.hpp" exit 1
          - if: win
            then: if not exist "%LIBRARY_INC%\iceoryx\v${{ version }}\iceoryx_versions.h" exit 1
          - if: win
            then: if not exist "%LIBRARY_INC%\iceoryx\v${{ version }}\iceoryx_platform\inet.hpp" exit 1

  - package:
      name: libiceoryx-hoofs-devel
    build:
      files:
        - if: unix
          then: include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_hoofs/
        - if: unix
          then: lib/cmake/iceoryx_hoofs/
        - if: win
          then: Library/include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_hoofs/
        - if: win
          then: Library/lib/cmake/iceoryx_hoofs/
        - if: win
          then: Library/lib/iceoryx_hoofs*.lib
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - if: unix
          then: make
        - if: win
          then: ninja
      host:
        - if: linux
          then: libacl
        - if: unix
          then: ncurses
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-hoofs", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-platform-devel", exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-hoofs", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then: test -f ${PREFIX}/include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_hoofs/iceoryx_hoofs_types.hpp
          - if: win
            then: if not exist "%LIBRARY_INC%\iceoryx\v${{ version }}\iceoryx_hoofs\iceoryx_hoofs_types.hpp" exit 1

  - package:
      name: libiceoryx-posh-devel
    build:
      files:
        - if: unix
          then: include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_posh/
        - if: unix
          then: lib/cmake/iceoryx_posh/
        - if: win
          then: Library/include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_posh/
        - if: win
          then: Library/lib/cmake/iceoryx_posh/
        - if: win
          then: Library/lib/iceoryx_posh*.lib
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - if: unix
          then: make
        - if: win
          then: ninja
      host:
        - if: linux
          then: libacl
        - if: unix
          then: ncurses
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-hoofs-devel", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-posh", exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-posh", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-hoofs", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then: test -f ${PREFIX}/include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_posh/version/version_info.hpp
          - if: win
            then: if not exist "%LIBRARY_INC%\iceoryx\v${{ version }}\iceoryx_posh\version\version_info.hpp" exit 1

  - package:
      name: libiceoryx-binding-c-devel
    build:
      files:
        - if: unix
          then: include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_binding_c/
        - if: unix
          then: lib/cmake/iceoryx_binding/
        - if: win
          then: Library/include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_binding_c/
        - if: win
          then: Library/lib/cmake/iceoryx_binding/
        - if: win
          then: Library/lib/iceoryx_binding_c*.lib
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - if: unix
          then: make
        - if: win
          then: ninja
      host:
        - if: linux
          then: libacl
        - if: unix
          then: ncurses
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-hoofs-devel", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-posh-devel", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-binding-c", exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-binding-c", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then: test -f ${PREFIX}/include/iceoryx/v${{ version }}/iceoryx_posh/version/version_info.hpp
          - if: win
            then: if not exist "%LIBRARY_INC%\iceoryx\v${{ version }}\iceoryx_posh\version\version_info.hpp" exit 1

  - package:
      name: iceoryx
    build:
      files:
        - if: unix
          then: share/doc/
        - if: unix
          then: bin/iox-roudi
        - if: unix
          then: etc/roudi_config_example.toml
        - if: win
          then: Library/share/doc/
        - if: win
          then: Library/bin/iox-roudi.exe
        - if: win
          then: Library/etc/roudi_config_example.toml
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - if: unix
          then: make
        - if: win
          then: ninja
      host:
        - if: linux
          then: libacl
        - if: unix
          then: ncurses
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-hoofs", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-posh", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-binding-c", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-hoofs-devel", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-posh-devel", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-binding-c-devel", exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-hoofs", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-posh", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-binding-c", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-hoofs-devel", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-posh-devel", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libiceoryx-binding-c-devel", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: not win
            then: iox-roudi -h

about:
  summary: Eclipse iceoryx - true zero-copy inter-process-communication
  description: |
    Eclipse iceoryx is an inter-process-communication middleware that enables
    virtually limitless data transmissions at constant time.
  license: Apache-2.0 AND MIT AND EPL-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - iceoryx_posh/doc/3rd_party_licenses/cpptoml/LICENSE
  homepage: https://iceoryx.io/
  repository: https://github.com/eclipse-iceoryx/iceoryx
  documentation: https://iceoryx.io/latest/

extra:
  feedstock-name: iceoryx
  recipe-maintainers:
    - timkpaine
